d:
My first day driving in Chile did not go according to plan.
After crossing into Chile, I rented a Chevrolet Colorado 4x4 to begin exploring the Atacama Desert, one of the driest and most extraordinary landscapes on Earth. The Atacama stretches across northern Chile between the Pacific coast and the Andes, with huge salt flats, volcanoes, high altitude lagoons and landscapes that sometimes look more like another planet than South America.
